title: 第336章 善恶到头终有报第335章 估计是被打怕了
content_zh:
说完，他重新摊开那本名册，手指在上面点了点。
“至于下一家，就选这个灵元宗。”
“好！”几人纷纷点头。
白锦儿看着册子上记载的那些恶事，冷哼一声：
“这个灵元宗一看就不是什么好东西，大王去收拾他们一顿，也算替修仙界惩罚这一窝祸害，让他们长长记性！”
纯小白听得老脸微微一抽。
他选中灵元宗，倒也不是因为他们干的缺德事多。
主要是因为近。
而且按照地图上的标注，灵元宗附近宗门林立，各方势力错综复杂，即便身份中途穿帮，也方便他们趁乱脱身。
这买卖才做了两次，众人经验尚浅，不能一上来就挑最难啃的骨头，得先找个方便下手、方便跑路的冤大头，把路子彻底走熟。
煮熟了以后再干这些难啃的骨头，那就容易多了。
“行，就这么定了！”
陆青山眯着眼睛，笑得满脸褶子。
“灵元宗抽了别人这么多年的本源，如今也该轮到他们放放血了。”
“正所谓，善恶到头终有报，不是不报，时候未到啊！”
纯小白摆了摆手。
“给你两天时间，先替本大王找三个实力高深、办事可靠之人。”
“至于工钱，每人十个亿灵石，试用期过了也跟我们一样分成！”
“丑话说在前面，人是你找来的就得由你负责，谁要是出了问题，本大王第一个找你！”
“放心！”陆青山收起笑容，一脸正色。

“你难道还信不过本长老看人的眼光？”
“嘁！”白玉堂不屑地把头扭到一边。
这老杂毛也好意思说自己眼光好？
之前纯小白没回来时，数他最怂，事情还没个结果，他便已经惦记着分钱散伙，各回各家。
陆青山哪能看不出白玉堂的意思？
不过，他也懒得反驳。
当时他确实认为纯小白十死无生，谁能想到这个悍匪不仅从万花宗逃了出来，还真把一百亿灵石弄到了手？
从纯小白活着推开房门的那一刻起，陆青山便知道，自己这次算是跟对人了。
跟着这小子，往后的日子有盼头。
更要紧的是，招人这件事里面也有油水！
先前他还在青云宗时，那些长老在他山头上蹭灵气，转手介绍几个人进来，都能赚上一大笔介绍费。
如今自己回青云宗拉高手入伙，这介绍费十个亿中的提成，岂不是……
content_en:
After saying that, he unfolded the roster again and tapped his finger on it.
"As for the next family, choose this Lingyuan Sect."
"Okay!" Several people nodded.
Bai Jin'er looked at the evil things recorded in the book and snorted coldly:
"This Lingyuan Sect is not a good thing at first glance. If your Majesty goes to deal with them, you can punish this scourge for the world of immortality and let them remember it for a long time!"
Chun Xiaobai's old face twitched slightly when he heard this.
He chose Lingyuan Sect not because they did many evil things.
Mainly because of the proximity.
Moreover, according to the markings on the map, there are many sects near Lingyuan Sect, and the forces of all parties are complicated. Even if their identities change, it will be convenient for them to escape in the chaos.
This transaction has only been done twice, and everyone has little experience. They cannot pick the hardest bones right away. They must first find a prey that is easy to start and escape, and thoroughly familiarize themselves with the process.
It will be much easier to dry these tough bones after they are cooked.
"Okay, it's settled!"
Lu Qingshan squinted his eyes and smiled with wrinkles on his face.
"Lingyuan Sect has extracted the origins of others for so many years, and now it's their turn to bleed them."
"As the saying goes, good and evil will be rewarded in the end. It's not that we won't be rewarded. The time has not yet come!"
Chun Xiaobai waved his hand.
"I'll give you two days to find three capable and reliable people for my king."
"As for the salary, each person has one billion spiritual stones. After the trial period, they will be divided into the same amount as us!"
"The ugly words are coming from the front. You are the one who found this person, so you have to be responsible for it. If someone has a problem, I, the King, will be the first to come to you!"
"Don't worry!" Lu Qingshan put away his smile and looked serious.
"Don't you still believe how I see people?"
"Hey!" Bai Yutang turned his head to the side in disdain.
Does this old bastard have the nerve to say that he has good taste?
Before Chun Xiaobai didn't come back, he was the most timid. Before the matter came to a conclusion, he was already thinking about dividing the money and breaking up the gang, each going back to his own home.
How could Lu Qingshan not see what Bai Yutang meant?
However, he didn't bother to refute.
At that time, he really believed that Chun Xiaobai was dead. Who would have thought that this gangster not only escaped from the Ten Thousand Flowers Sect, but actually got 10 billion spiritual stones?
From the moment Chun Xiaobai opened the door alive, Lu Qingshan knew that he was with the right person this time.
If you follow this boy, you will have hope for the future.
What’s more important is that there is also oil and water involved in recruiting people!
When he was still in the Qingyun Sect, the elders used spiritual energy on his mountaintop and introduced a few people to them, earning a large sum of money in introduction fees.
Now that I have returned to the Qingyun Sect to recruit experts to join the team, wouldn't it be that the commission from the one billion introduction fee...
